title: Clarify the focus navigation scope owner of popover element
body:
### What is the issue with the HTML Standard? The spec and existing implantation are mismatched. The popover element's focus navigation owner is popover element itself per spec, see https://html.spec.whatwg.org/#focus-navigation-scope-owner, > Every element element has an associated focus navigation owner, which is either null or a [focus navigation scope owner](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/#focus-navigation-scope-owner). It is determined by the following algorithm: > 1. If element's parent is null, then return null. > 2. If element's parent is a [shadow host](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#element-shadow-host), then return element's [assigned slot](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#slotable-assigned-slot). > 3. If element's parent is a [shadow root](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-shadow-root), then return the parent's [host](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-documentfragment-host). > 4. If element's parent is the [document element](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#document-element), then return the parent's [node document](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-node-document). > 5. If element is in the [popover showing state](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/#popover-showing-state) and has a [popover invoker](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/#popover-invoker) set, then return element. > 6. Return element's parent's [associated focus navigation owner](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/#associated-focus-navigation-owner). Consider this test case, ```html 1 - Link
Welcome to this Popover.
4 - Link ``` If I read spec correctly, the sequential focus navigation order defined in the spec should be `1 - Link` -> `3 - Close popover` -> `2 - Toggle popover` -> `4 - Link` However, the sequential focus navigation order on all browsers is `1 - Link` -> `2 - Toggle popover` -> `3 - Close popover` -> `4 - Link` It looks like all implementers use `popover invoker` as the focus navigation scope owner. I am not sure if this is a spec issue or an implementation bug? cc @josepharhar, @annevk
